prd_summary.problem: About 400 permit renewals a month arrive by email and walk-in and are re-typed into a spreadsheet; unpaid fines and slow decisions are not visible.
goals: Capture renewals through one online form
Block approval when fines are unpaid
non_goals: Renewals for permits expired more than 6 months ago

epics.title: Renewal request intake
epics.goal: Capture every renewal request once, with a reference number

epics.title: Approval controls
epics.goal: Approve only renewals with no unpaid fines and visible fees

epics.title: Follow-up
epics.goal: Find requests quickly and surface overdue ones

stories.title: Online renewal form
stories.want: an online renewal form that captures permit number, company name, contact email and renewal period
stories.so_that: I no longer re-type requests from email into a spreadsheet

acceptance_criteria.when: I submit it with all four fields completed and a period of 1 or 2 years
acceptance_criteria.then: the request is saved with status Submitted

acceptance_criteria.given: the renewal form with the permit number empty
acceptance_criteria.then: the message Permit number is required is shown and nothing is saved
the page loads fast and shows the details

stories.evidence_quote: Agents want an online renewal request form that captures the permit number, company name, contact email and the renewal period

stories.title: Reference number per request
stories.want: every renewal request to get a reference number
stories.so_that: customers can quote it when they call

acceptance_criteria.then: a unique reference number in the format RN-000001 is shown

acceptance_criteria.given: two requests submitted one after the other

stories.evidence_quote: Every renewal request must get a reference number that the customer can quote when they call.

stories.title: Block approval when fines are unpaid
stories.want: approval to be blocked when the company has unpaid fines
stories.so_that: no permit is renewed while fines are outstanding

acceptance_criteria.given: a company with AED 500 of unpaid fines
acceptance_criteria.then: the outstanding amount AED 500 is shown and Send for approval is disabled

acceptance_criteria.given: a company with no unpaid fines

stories.evidence_quote: a renewal cannot be approved if the company has unpaid fines

stories.title: Show renewal fee before submission
stories.want: the renewal fee to be shown before the request is submitted
stories.so_that: the customer knows the cost up front

acceptance_criteria.given: a renewal period of 1 year is selected
a renewal period of 2 years is selected

stories.evidence_quote: the fee must be shown before the customer submits

stories.title: Search by permit or reference number
stories.want: to search requests by permit number or reference number
stories.so_that: I can answer phone calls without asking the customer to wait

acceptance_criteria.given: no request with permit number P-999
acceptance_criteria.then: the message No matching requests is shown

stories.evidence_quote: Agents asked for a search by permit number or reference number

stories.title: Highlight overdue requests
stories.want: requests older than 5 working days without a decision to be highlighted for the supervisor
stories.so_that: slow renewals are noticed and chased

acceptance_criteria.given: a request submitted 6 working days ago with no decision
acceptance_criteria.when: the supervisor opens the request list
acceptance_criteria.then: the request is shown with an Overdue label

acceptance_criteria.given: a request submitted 3 working days ago
acceptance_criteria.when: the supervisor opens the request list
acceptance_criteria.then: no Overdue label is shown for it

stories.evidence_quote: wants requests older than 5 working days without a decision to be highlighted for the supervisor

open_questions.question: Should customers receive an SMS, or only an email, when a renewal is approved?

decisions.decision: Renewals for permits expired more than 6 months ago are out of scope and use the new-permit process.
